WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval AS status,
         SUM(c.scancount) AS total_scans,
         SUM(c.gbsize) / SUM(c.spanmin) AS gb_per_minute
  FROM scans AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
), with_average AS (
  SELECT status,
         total_scans,
         gb_per_minute,
         AVG(gb_per_minute) OVER () AS average_rate
  FROM status_rates
)
SELECT status,
       total_scans,
       gb_per_minute,
       gb_per_minute - average_rate AS above_average
FROM with_average
WHERE gb_per_minute > average_rate
ORDER BY status
